about: What fire does to the voxels of an object (web/systems/burn.js). Each part of an object (its role: trunk, canopy, stone, water) has a material; a stone part whose palette is named in `palettes` has that material instead (the wooden crates and beams are stone parts with the wood palette). A material: burns (it can catch fire), catches (how much of the heat of the fire next to it it takes: more catches fire sooner), burnTime (seconds it burns and gives heat), emberTime (seconds its embers glow, about), after (what is left once it burned: char = it stays black; gone = it turns black, then grey ash, and is gone), charTime (after: gone: seconds it stays black and ash before it is gone), falls (once it caught fire, it falls when the voxel under it is gone).
